# lokalise_project_language (Resource)

A language added to a Lokalise project. This resource manages exactly the language it created; it never removes any other language, and a project's base language cannot be deleted through this resource (see `deletion_protection`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lokalise_project_language" "french" {
  project_id = lokalise_project.example.id
  lang_iso   = "fr"

  # custom_name and plural_forms default to Lokalise's values for lang_iso.
  # custom_name  = "French (FR)"
  # plural_forms = ["one", "other"]

  # deletion_protection defaults to true: `terraform destroy` fails instead of
  # deleting the language. Set it to false and apply before destroying or
  # replacing it. Has no effect on the project's base language, which this
  # resource never deletes: removing it only clears Terraform state.
  # deletion_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lang_iso` (String) Language code, e.g. `fr`. Can be changed in place.
- `project_id` (String) Lokalise project ID. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `custom_name` (String) Display name for the language. Defaults to Lokalise's name for `lang_iso`. When unset, the current name is kept.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When `true` (the default), destroying this resource fails instead of deleting the language. Set to `false` and apply before destroying. Imported languages get `true`. Has no effect on the project's base language, which this resource never deletes.
- `plural_forms` (List of String) Plural forms for the language, e.g. `["one", "other"]`. Defaults to Lokalise's forms for `lang_iso`. When unset, the current forms are kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `project_id:lang_id`.
- `lang_id` (Number) Lokalise's system-wide language ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_project_language.french <project_id>:<lang_iso>
```
